def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out

    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)

    inset = 1
    while bottom - top + 1 - 2 * inset > 3 and right - left + 1 - 2 * inset > 3:
        color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
        r1, r2 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c1, c2 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
            out[r1][c] = color
            out[r2][c] = color
        for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
            out[r][c1] = color
            out[r][c2] = color
        inset += 1

    return out

    layers = (min(h, w) - 1) // 2

        color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
        for r in range(top + inset, bottom - inset + 1):
            for c in range(left + inset, right - inset + 1):

    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out

    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
    inset = 1

    # Alternate colored square frames inward. Small odd frames retain a
    # blank 3x3 center; larger frames continue to their central cell.
    odd_small = min(h, w) <= 9 and min(h, w) % 2 == 1
    while True:
        rh = h - 2 * inset
        rw = w - 2 * inset
        if rh <= 0 or rw <= 0:
            break
        if rh == rw == 3 and odd_small:
            break
        if rh == rw == 1:
            color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
            out[top + inset][left + inset] = color
            break
        if rh == rw == 2:
            color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
            for r in range(top + inset, bottom - inset + 1):
                for c in range(left + inset, right - inset + 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
            break

        color = 2 if inset % 2 else 5
        r1, r2 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c1, c2 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
            out[r1][c] = color
            out[r2][c] = color
        for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
            out[r][c1] = color
            out[r][c2] = color
        inset += 1

    return out
